Each training example transforms an input grid of zeros into a grid-like mesh of blue (`1`s) and background (`0`s):
- Cells at even row indices or even column indices (`r % 2 == 0` or `c % 2 == 0`, using 0-based indexing) are set to `1`.
- Cells where both the row index and column index are odd (`r % 2 != 0` and `c % 2 != 0`) remain `0`.

I am ready for the test input.
